objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled artifact subject to versioning, release workflow, and validity management in the policies and guidelines management system.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type equivalent to process instructions defining roles, objectives, framework and process sequence.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A document template that can be selected when creating new documents of a specific type.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is released with the main document and triggers versioning of the main document upon modification.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not trigger new versions.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A planned amendment to an existing document that does not affect the content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: An automatically generated request to review a document for continued validity before its expiration date.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document invalid and archive it when it no longer has validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously archived and invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with assigned roles and authorizations within the system.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned to specific roles or locations.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user role with creation and editing rights on documents and all dependent objects.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user role with editing rights on documents but no relevance in the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user role responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user role responsible for deciding whether a document is distributed to readers and approving its release.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user role authorized to translate released content into other languages.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user role with view-only access to approved documents and dependent objects.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of users and user groups assigned to receive notifications or acknowledgements for a document.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process for document approval consisting of creator, review, and release steps.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to document release actions.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A system record of all actions and signatures applied to documents for traceability.

objs.name: version
objs.description: A distinct iteration of a document with its own status and release history.

objs.name: status
objs.description: The current state of a document in its lifecycle such as editing, released, or archived.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Descriptive information and properties maintained for a document including standardized and customer-specific attributes.

objs.name: validity_period
objs.description: The time interval during which a released document remains valid.

objs.name: archive
objs.description: A repository where invalidated documents are stored with restricted access for a defined archive duration.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user interface providing role-specific and distribution-specific views of relevant documents.

objs.name: evaluation_report
objs.description: A role-specific report providing filtered information about documents based on selected parameters.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A document translated into an alternative language from the original version.

objs.name: pdf_conversion
objs.description: An automatic system-supported format conversion of documents to PDF for web display.

objs.name: tag_technology
objs.description: A mechanism to automatically embed document metadata such as version and status into document content.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference information in the system such as IT applications, organizational units, and risks that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A department or business area to which documents can be assigned for targeted storage and distribution.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A hazard or concern that can be referenced and linked to policy or guideline documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A software system that can be referenced and linked to documents.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: An active confirmation by a reader of receipt and understanding of a document.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A separate instance in a multi-client system where documents may or may not be visible.

objs.name: dual_control_principle
objs.description: A governance rule that the same person cannot be both author and reviewer of a document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new document object to the system by selecting a document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modify the content, metadata, or properties of a document using the system editor.

evts.name: upload_attachment
evts.description: Add an external file or attachment to a document object.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Define or update standardized and customer-specific metadata attributes for a document.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign read, write, or role-specific permissions to users or user groups for a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a planned amendment to an existing document without affecting the current version.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Mark a change proposal as implemented and no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiate the 3-step approval workflow by the author or co-authors.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check and evaluate document content according to technical and formal aspects by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document for distribution to readers by a releaser.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply an electronic signature to document release by workflow participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document automatically visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version of a released document for content or property modifications.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an existing attachment as no longer relevant for a new document version.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Update the valid-until date of a document after completing a validity review.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatically generate a request for validity review when a document reaches 30 days before expiration.

evts.name: process_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Complete a validity extension workflow by releaser or by author, reviewer, and releaser.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to declare a document invalid and archive it.

evts.name: process_override_request
evts.description: Complete an override workflow to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Issue the final decision to invalidate a document and begin its archive period.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw authorizations for a document while retaining it for a defined archive duration.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to re-validate a previously archived and invalidated document.

evts.name: approve_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation of an archived document and create a new valid version.

evts.name: assign_to_distribution_list
evts.description: Add users or user groups to a document's distribution list for notifications or acknowledgements.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Send email notification to users in the distribution list when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically send a workflow-supported acknowledgement request to users in the distribution list upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Actively verify receipt and understanding of a document by a reader.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the accuracy and completeness of a translated document version.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish a translated version of a document.

evts.name: view_document
evts.description: Access and display a document or its content in the system.

evts.name: generate_evaluation_report
evts.description: Create a filtered report of documents based on role-specific or parameterized selection criteria.

evts.name: search_documents
evts.description: Query documents in the system using selection parameters and criteria.
